name: imagegen-mcp-app
description: Remote MCP server (Cloudflare Worker) that lets Claude generate and edit images with OpenAI GPT Image 2.5 and Google Nano Banana.

MCP_TOKEN.description: A long random string (at least 16 characters; let your password manager generate one). It is the password in your Claude connector URL: `https://<worker>.workers.dev/mcp/<MCP_TOKEN>`. Save it somewhere, you'll need it in the next step.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Your [OpenAI API key](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys), used for the GPT Image 2.5 models.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Your [Gemini API key](https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey), used for the Nano Banana models.

IMAGES.description: R2 bucket where generated images are stored (R2 must be enabled on your account once).

DEFAULT_MODEL.description: Model used when you don't name one: `gpt-image-2.5-flare`, `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst`, `gemini-nano-banana-2.1` or `gemini-3.1-flash-image`.

DAILY_LIMIT.description: Maximum images per day (UTC), a safety net against runaway costs. `0` turns it off.
